localChanges: chore: lock the engine package that makes Isaac Newton's College and Hoover Dam work

log: IsaacNewtonsCollege: an extra x11/9 Research per Library and per University in the owner's cities (+50% -> +83% each), until Nuclear Fission. A multiplier, because yield bonuses compound and this package's rules can register before civ1-city-improvement's (civ-clone/web-renderer#390).
HooverDam: +50% Production in the owner's cities on the Dam's continent that have a Factory or Mfg. Plant and no Power/Hydro/Nuclear Plant.
MichelangelosChapel: a Cathedral makes 6 content, not 8 (adds 2 to civ1-city-happiness's 4).
JsBachsCathedral: only the owner's cities on its own continent.
New onWonderLandMass criterion; cost and yield-modifier getRules take a LandMassRegistry (and CityImprovementRegistry), passed from the Game.

One X Low (4000) rule with a single floor, ×11/9 per Library or University (×121/81 for both), instead of a Low rule per improvement. civ1-wonder registers before civ1-city-improvement in the renderer, so Newton's used to floor before the Library: base 12 gave 21, not v474.05's 22. Tests cover base 12 with the Library/University stand-ins (now Low, as the real rules are) registered before and after this package's.
